steps.en: Officer changes the surcharge amount of a stage on the settings page
steps.id: Officer mengubah jumlah surcharge tiap stage di halaman pengaturan

steps.en: Moving a notice to a court stage adds the surcharge to the amount due
steps.id: Memindahkan notice ke court stage menambah surcharge ke jumlah yang harus dibayar

steps.en: The applied surcharge is also saved on the notice record
steps.id: Surcharge yang berlaku juga disimpan di catatan notice
steps.why_en: Saved for changes made in the staff portal, but not for changes coming from the PLUS system.
steps.why_id: Tersimpan untuk perubahan dari portal staff, tetapi tidak untuk perubahan dari sistem PLUS.

steps.en: The extra charge at the final reminder can be set on its own
steps.id: Biaya tambahan di final reminder bisa diatur sendiri
steps.why_en: It exists, but it is called an administration fee, not a surcharge.
steps.why_id: Ada, tetapi namanya biaya administrasi, bukan surcharge.

steps.en: Automatic processes use the same configured surcharge
steps.id: Proses otomatis memakai surcharge yang sama dari pengaturan
steps.why_en: Revival and the staff portal treat one court stage differently, and no daily job adds the surcharge.
steps.why_id: Revival dan portal staff memperlakukan satu court stage secara berbeda, dan tidak ada job harian yang menambah surcharge.
